author: desktop_review
purpose: Short real GTK4/libadwaita GSK scroll comparison with current renderer versus per-process Cairo
records: CPU time before map and during sample
validity: Requires unblocked session before and after, a renderer, changed scroll offset, and at least120 after-paint intervals. Does not verify physical scanout, input latency or intermediate session changes. Native stalls can delay GLib timers; caller should bound process lifetime externally.
comparison_constraints: Fresh NON_UNIQUE process for each. Keep all other environment equal; do not globally switch desktop renderer. Report cold/warm order because shader and font caches can affect results.
